title: No guest reads through AppSync on the shared stack
description:
Outcome: PublishedItem, PublishedMediaAsset, PublishedEdition, PublishedEditionItem, PublishedCategorySet and PublishedCategory allow guest read (allow.guest().to(["read"])). On a shared API any visitor could list every tenant's published rows and run up AppSync cost. Shared-tier public reads come only from the static projection in S3 through CloudFront; the reader API (reader-steering) uses its own function. The guest rules are dropped on the shared stack only (the Pretext reader on dedicated sites still uses them).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/data/schema.ts (six Published* models), amplify/backend site config (tenancy mode), docs/public-surface.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-stack-no-guest-api.feature):
Scenario: A guest cannot list published rows on the shared stack
    Given the shared stack
    When an unauthenticated identity lists PublishedItem
    Then the call is denied

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-46635e, PPY-06ae68. Blocks PPY-bdc4ee. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Adversarial suite; schema parity test asserts no guest rule when tenancy mode is shared.
Rollout: Shared stack only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a static page island quietly depended on guest AppSync. Mitigation: grep of web assets and the projection's islands before the change; browser test of a tenant site with the network panel.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: removes guest read on six models (shared stack).
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
